paragraphs: SKIDATA sells access systems for people and vehicles, covering entry to car parks, mountain destinations and stadiums. Alongside the equipment the company markets SKIDATA Connect, a platform that links visitors, existing infrastructure and integrated partner solutions and apps.

For parking and mobility the same platform is described as handling access, EV-Charging, reporting, analytics and payments, digital and on-site. Access control manages vehicle entry and exit in car parks, with license plate recognition offered alongside ticket-based parking. A separate monitoring and control product runs car parks from one central point instead of local on-site management at each site.

The parking pages name the settings the systems are sold into, including airports, cities, hotels, hospitals, educational buildings, shopping centers, and office buildings. Cities and municipalities are listed as a segment, with car parks turned into mobility hubs for last-mile parking or park-and-ride. Parking operators are listed separately, monitoring and controlling all their car parks from one point.
